# Arsenii Pylypenko

> Arsenii Pylypenko is a Senior Frontend Engineer focused on high-performance SaaS platforms, AI tools, MVP development, frontend architecture, and AI system integration.

This site is a portfolio for evaluating Arsenii's engineering work, services, selected projects, writing, and contact options. Use the links below as the primary entry points for understanding the site's content.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](/): Portfolio overview, positioning, services, selected work, process, clients, writing, and contact section.
- [Selected work](/#work): Case-study style overview of projects across AI tools, SaaS products, dashboards, and Web3 platforms.
- [Expertise](/#expertise): Core engineering areas including AI tools, frontend engineering, MVP development, performance optimization, and scalable web applications.
- [Process](/#process): Product and engineering workflow from discovery through launch and optimization.
- [Contact](/#contact): Ways to start a project or connect with Arsenii.

## Projects

- [AI PR Review Assistant](/project/ai-pr-review-assistant): AI-powered GitHub App concept for reviewing pull requests and improving code quality.
- [Focus AI](/project/focus-ai): AI productivity product concept that turns goals and scattered ideas into execution plans.
- [Enterprise Security Dashboard](/project/enterprise-security-dashboard): Frontend engineering case study for data-heavy dashboards and scalable interface architecture.
- [RAIR Technologies](/project/rair-tech): Production Web3 platform work with digital ownership, MetaMask integration, and smart contract interactions.

## Articles
